subject: Promotional allowance & invoice offset request for pilot usage
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@greenfield.ai>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com
Cc: billing@greenfield.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Question about invoice 874 — pilot credit?

Hi Priyom,

Hope you're well. We received invoice #874 this morning for $4,200 tied to our October pilot. We understood the pilot would include a promotional allowance covering the first month of usage — our internal finance team is flagging the charge and asked whether Redwood can either: (a) issue a credit memo to offset the invoice, or (b) confirm a trial extension and apply a promotional credit in the ledger so we don't short-pay.

Attached is the invoice we received and a short usage CSV from our side (pilot_usage_report_202610.csv). Can you advise next steps? We need to get this cleared before our month-end close on Nov 10.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Data & Analytics
GreenField Analytics
Elena@greenfield.ai

Attachment(s): GF-invoice-874.pdf, pilot_usage_report_202610.csv
From: priyom.das@redwood.com <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@greenfield.ai>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Question about invoice 874 — pilot credit?

Thanks for the note, Elena — and sorry for the confusion here.

Short answer: we can do a one-time promotional allowance to offset the October invoice and extend your pilot period by 30 days at no charge while we finalize the integration. I will route this to finance for a formal credit memo so it shows up correctly in your ledger.

Proposed plan:
- Redwood issues a $4,200 credit memo against invoice #874 (full offset).
- We apply a 30-day trial extension to your account (no charges during that period).
- Finance will provide the credit memo number and GL mapping so GreenField can post the adjustment.

Action items:
- I will get Sean to authorize the credit memo and loop in Marcus from accounting for the GLA mapping.
- Elena, could you confirm the bill-to entity and VAT/GST handling (if any)? If you have a PO number please share so we can reference it.

I'll follow up shortly with the finance confirmation.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
From: monica.patel@redwood.com <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Promo allowance approval request (GreenField)

Forwarding the customer details and usage — tagging finance for fast turn here. We ran a short quality check on the usage file; looks like standard pilot traffic, no unusual tokens. Recommend full offset given this was an onboarding friction case and GreenField is progressing toward a committed Dedicated deployment (see deal notes).

Please see the attached proposed mutual action plan (proposed-map-MAP_v1.2.docx) that lays out extension dates and success criteria.

Elena — small ask for accounting: confirm the legal entity name and PO if available. That will speed the credit memo.

Monica Patel

Redwood Inference

From: sean.gallagher@redwood.com <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Promo allowance approval request (GreenField) — credit memo instructions

Approved: finance will issue a credit memo to offset invoice #874 in full. Marcus, please create Credit Memo CM-2026-1121 referencing Invoice 874 and map to GL 6540 (Sales Promotions). Provide the customer-facing CM PDF and the internal journal entry ID.

Notes for accounting entry:
- Customer: GreenField Analytics (legal: GreenField Analytics, Inc.)
- Invoice: 874 (dated 2026-10-31)
- Credit amount: $4,200.00 USD
- Reason: Pilot promotional allowance agreed by sales/CX due to onboarding friction
- Apply open AR offset so customer sees zero balance for that invoice

Marcus — please confirm once CM is issued and paste the DocuSign envelope link for Elena to acknowledge (per her procurement). Also include the internal journal entry id and suggested GLA mapping for revenue forecasting teams.

Elena — we will send the customer copy to your billing inbox (billing@greenfield.ai) and the DocuSign link for acknowledgment. Trial extension has been applied today for 30 days; you should see the change in the Console under Account > Plan.

Thanks team — moving to done upon CM issuance.

Sean Gallagher
